responsibility: Defines the master enumeration list of all GIMPLE statement codes and their associated storage-layout classes via DEFGSCODE entries. It is the declarative source used to generate the gimple_code enum, code-name tables, and code-to-structure mappings, and its comments document the semantic contract and operand layout for each statement kind, including core control-flow, assignment, EH, OpenMP/OpenACC, transactional-memory, debug, and gimplifier-only tuples.
same_name_distinction: Declarative definition list for GIMPLE statement codes and their structure classes via DEFGSCODE entries, used to generate enums and tables consumed by gcc/gimple.h and gcc/gimple.cc; unlike those files, it is not an API header or implementation file.
